papers.title_en: Coopshift: Post-Training Amplifies The Memory Curse In LLM Cooperation
papers.authors: Jiayuan Liu, Shiyi Du, Tianqin Li, Emanuel Tewolde, Keyang Xuan, Vincent Conitzer
papers.evidence: 比较语言模型在七种社会困境中的重复互动合作
papers.tldr: 后训练能否让大模型在反复互动中持续合作，不能仅凭单次选择判断。研究比较七个模型谱系的预训练、监督微调和偏好或奖励优化检查点，在七类社会困境中自我对弈两百轮，并将可见历史设为两轮或四十轮。六类二元行动游戏的平均结果显示，所有后训练检查点在历史变长后合作率均下降，且放大效应大部分已在监督微调阶段出现。这说明后训练不必然改善持续合作，评估还需覆盖互动历史、收益结构与未来互动预期。
papers.abstract_en: How does post-training change cooperation during repeated interaction? Within each of seven released model lineages, we compare pretrained (Base), supervised fine-tuned (SFT), and subsequent preference- or reward-optimized (Aligned) checkpoints across seven social dilemmas. Copies of each checkpoint play one another for 200 rounds, with visible history limited to the last two or forty rounds. The memory curse refers to lower cooperation when agents can see more past rounds. Our central finding is that post-training amplifies this decline. Averaged across the six binary-action games, expanding visible history reduces cooperation at every SFT and Aligned checkpoint. At each post-trained stage, these declines exceed Base's in six of seven lineages. Most of this average amplification is already present at SFT. With long history, both post-trained stages also cooperate less than Base on average in each binary-action game. In the symmetric binary games, their fitted cooperation rates fall more steeply on average than Base's as per-round cooperation costs rise, benefits fall, or noncooperation becomes more rewarding. The difference in cooperation rates between Aligned and SFT also changes from one-shot decisions to repeated play. When given the same past records, their choices depend on whether the instructions describe a final round or possible future interaction. Post-training evaluation should therefore go beyond isolated choices to assess whether cooperation is sustained in repeated interaction and how it depends on payoffs and visible history.

papers.title_en: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
papers.authors: Chenhan Lyu, Kit Wislocki, Sarah Elizabeth Stoeckl, Maitreyi Sinha, Amir Rahmani
papers.evidence: 临床人员制定可检查规则，约束心理健康聊天机器人的输出
papers.tldr: 心理健康聊天机器人的安全判定往往难以解释和复核。研究由两名临床专家制定四项安全检查，将规则库形式化验证，再依据十六项事实生成可重算的判定。对照裁判模型在已有危机资源的65条回复中，仍对55条要求补充资源；规则层可避免此类矛盾，但裁判模型的危机误报更少，规则修订也使边界提示的阻断比例从6%升至16%。贡献不在于证明判定更安全，而在于将分歧与代价定位到具体规则、事实及不确定性默认策略。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.

papers.title_en: LocoPilot: Single-Operator Bilateral Teleoperation for Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning
papers.authors: Antonio Langella, Giovanni Minelli, Giovanni B. Dessy, Lorenzo Amatucci, Giulio Turrisi, Victor Barasuol, Claudio Semini
papers.evidence: 提出用于机器人操作示范采集的双向遥操作界面
papers.tldr: 移动操作策略需要同时包含底盘与机械臂协同动作的示范，但离线采集难以保留目标机器人的状态与视角。LocoPilot通过主机械臂和双手持控制器，让单人同步控制四足底盘、机身姿态、机械臂与夹爪，并提供无需专用力传感器的力反馈。系统统一遥操作与策略部署的11维动作接口，利用抓取放置示范微调MolmoAct2后完成实机部署，无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学。其贡献是打通具身示范采集到策略部署的链路。
papers.abstract_en: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot

papers.title_en: Train Locally, Learn Together: Distributed Multi-Agent Training via ADMM
papers.authors: Yiwei Chen, Changsheng Wang, Yicheng Lang, Qing Qu, Alfred O. Hero, Sijia Liu
papers.evidence: 提出多智能体间通过去中心化通信与本地学习协同提升能力
papers.tldr: 多智能体协同训练通常依赖中心训练器，难以适应跨设备、跨组织的数据与训练状态本地化需求。本文将协同学习建模为带共识约束的有限和优化问题，利用ADMM交替执行角色本地学习与智能体间共识通信。在智能体遭破坏的设置下，HarmBench攻击成功率最高降低26.4%，推理收益则与集中式训练相当。结果表明，无需中心训练器也能保留联合优化优势，为可扩展、具韧性的多智能体训练提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can outperform individual language-model agents by combining specialized roles, diverse reasoning processes, and collaborative decision-making. However, collaborative MAS training is typically centralized, requiring a common trainer to aggregate role-local trajectories and learning signals and maintain model and optimization states. This motivates a distributed multi-agent learning paradigm in which agents improve system-level capabilities through role-local learning and decentralized communication, paving the way toward scalable, resilient, and self-organizing MAS. To this end, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first optimization-grounded framework for distributed MAS training based on consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). We formulate collaborative MAS learning as a consensus-constrained finite-sum optimization problem, naturally lending itself to distributed optimization via ADMM. The proposed approach alternates role-local learning with inter-agent consensus using distributed communication protocols such as ring all-reduce, enabling joint optimization while keeping each agent's data and training state local. We evaluate our framework on distributed safety alignment and general reasoning tasks. Under compromised-agent settings, ADMM can reduce HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) by up to 26.4%, while achieving reasoning gains comparable to centralized training. These results show that distributed MAS training retains the benefits of centralized joint optimization without requiring a centralized trainer.

papers.title_en: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
papers.authors: Fuyao Zhang, Wenwen He, Jiaming Zhang, Yurong Hao, Xuan Wang, Guowei Guan, Che Wang, Longtao Huang, Wei Yang Bryan Lim
papers.evidence: 为交互式图形界面智能体动态筛选多模态信息
papers.tldr: 全模态GUI智能体同时接收截图、音视频、交互历史和设备状态，但各步所需证据不断变化，无关信息会引发累积性轨迹偏移。FocusGUI通过轻量适配器，依据当前步骤的决策参照动态筛选多模态证据，压缩后注入冻结解码器的嵌入。仅用动作监督训练，在四种骨干上平均提升动作类型匹配指标33.2，精确匹配达到原来的3倍。研究表明，逐步聚焦关键证据可在不微调骨干的情况下改善GUI动作预测。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

papers.title_en: REM: What to Store, When to Recall, What to Forget in Experience Memory for Coding Agents
papers.authors: Xinyi Lisa Chen, Pedro Herrero-Vidal, Xiaohan Chen, Xiaojing Yu, Cris Liu, Bingqing Song, Bin Xu, Suleiman A. Khan, You-Lin Chen
papers.evidence: 管理智能体长期任务中的记忆存储、调用与遗忘
papers.tldr: 编码智能体会产生大量任务经验，但既有系统侧重检索，难以判断何时需要经验及保留多久。REM将轨迹压缩为分阶段文档，在任务开始时注入；仅在检测到智能体受阻时提供实现记录，并在单次呈现后移除。在仓库级缺陷修复中，相关轨迹首位匹配率达68.7%，任务解决率由24.9%升至27.6%，成本降低17%。结果表明，经验复用不仅取决于检索准确性，更依赖存储、召回与遗忘的全生命周期管理。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents now autonomously complete long-horizon tasks, such as repository-level coding, through hundreds of think-act steps, yet the experience each run produces is rarely reused on the next. Prior memory systems concentrate on retrieval, finding the most relevant past trajectory. Retrieval cannot observe the running agent, so it cannot decide whether the agent needs an experience, at which point, or for how long. We introduce REM (Reusable Experience Memory), a framework that manages the memory lifecycle from inside the agent's think-act loop through three explicit decisions. What to store: each completed trajectory is consolidated into a phase-structured document, two orders of magnitude smaller than the trajectory. When to recall: the document is injected at the start of the task; the costlier implementation record is withheld until an in-loop gate detects the agent struggling. What to forget: the record is evicted after a single exposure. On repository-level bug fixing (SWE-ContextBench Lite), REM retrieves the related trajectory more accurately than every state-of-the-art memory system (68.7% vs. 55.6% match@1) and improves, in every replicate, end-task resolution (27.6% vs. 24.9%) at 17% lower cost. Injecting the same experience as a summary or raw trajectory, even when oracle-retrieved, does not. Ablating any of the three decisions reduces resolution. Altogether, these results demonstrate that the bottleneck in experience reuse is not retrieval fidelity but how experience is stored and governed across its lifecycle, opening a control-theoretic perspective on agent memory.

papers.title_en: Improved automatic speech-based cognitive assessment using neuropsychologically calibrated diagnostic labels
papers.authors: Madhurananda Pahar, Caitlin Illingworth, Adam Hampshire, Peter J Hellyer, Agata J Hampshire, Daniel Blackburn, Annalena Venneri, Heidi Christensen
papers.evidence: 利用对话语音与机器学习评估认知障碍
papers.tldr: 真实世界语音认知筛查数据常因自我转诊和临床核验不足而存在诊断标签噪声，限制模型性能。研究基于720名参与者的138小时会话语音，以神经心理测验表现重新校准标签，训练并验证分类模型。记忆及MoCA相关的标准分校准效果最佳，内部二分类F1从0.70升至0.83，多分类从0.54升至0.66，三个外部数据集也均有改善。结果强调，提升标签质量是改进语音认知评估的重要路径。
papers.abstract_en: Although automatic detection of cognitive impairment from conversational speech is a promising way, it becomes less accurate, as large real-world datasets often contain unreliable diagnostic labels due to self-referral and limited clinical verification, and here we investigated whether neuropsychologically calibrated diagnostic relabeling improves it. We analysed 138 hours of conversational speech from 720 participants, recalibrating unreliable diagnostic labels using attention, executive function, and memory performance via external clinical thresholds, Gaussian, and normative z-score calibration. Transformer-based classifiers were trained using both original and recalibrated labels and evaluated internally on 150 clinically verified participants and externally on Pitt, ADReSS and PROCESS-2 datasets. Memory- and MoCA-based z-score calibration produced the greatest improvements. Using our internal dataset, $F_1$ increased from $0.70$ to $0.83$ ($+13\%$) and from $0.54$ to $0.66$ ($+12\%$) for binary and multiclass classification, respectively. For external validation, the increases are $+4\%$, $+5\%$ and $+9\%$ on Pitt, ADReSS and PROCESS-2 corpus. Neuropsychologically calibrated relabeling substantially improves speech-based cognitive assessment, highlighting label quality, rather than model architecture, as a critical bottleneck in clinical AI for dementia screening.

papers.title_en: Let Agents Design How They Search: Automatic Interface Optimization for Agentic Search
papers.authors: Sangjune An, Jaeyoon Jung, Yumin Choi, Jinheon Baek, Junmo Cho, Sung Ju Hwang, Hae Beom Lee
papers.evidence: 优化语言模型智能体进行搜索时使用的界面与工具
papers.tldr: 智能体搜索依赖访问语料的接口，但现有接口通常由人工固定设计，难以适配不同语料。SearchWeaver利用搜索执行轨迹与任务奖励，联合优化语料预处理产物、可执行工具和使用说明，协调预先准备的信息、工具操作与智能体决策。在GPT-5.4-nano上，答案准确率从71.6%升至78.4%，四个检索子集的平均nDCG@10从45.7升至55.0。结果表明，面向下游表现自动协同设计接口，能够有效提升智能体搜索质量。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search depends on the interface through which a language-model agent accesses and explores a corpus. Existing interface designs are fixed by hand and applied unchanged to every corpus, although effective designs may depend on the corpus. We introduce SearchWeaver, a framework for automatic search interface optimization guided by downstream search performance. A proposer uses execution trajectories and task rewards to jointly revise corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions. This pro cess optimizes what information is prepared in advance, which operations tools perform, and which decisions remain with the search agent. With GPT-5.4-nano, the optimized interfaces improve answer accuracy from 71.6% to 78.4% on BrowseComp-Plus and average nDCG@10 from 45.7 to 55.0 across four BRIGHT subsets over Direct Corpus Interaction. These findings highlight the value of jointly optimizing corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions to develop effective search interfaces.

papers.title_en: Differentially Private Sparse Reward Estimation with Preference Feedback
papers.authors: Meng Ding, Mingxi Lei, Jie Zhang, Jinyan Liu, Di Wang
papers.evidence: 研究利用人类偏好反馈进行隐私保护的强化学习奖励估计。
papers.tldr: 人类反馈强化学习依赖敏感偏好数据，而现有私有奖励估计的误差随模型维度增长，难以适用于高维模型。本文假设奖励仅由少量相关特征决定，在成对偏好的布拉德利–特里–卢斯模型下，提出样本级与标签级差分隐私估计算法。理论上，样本级误差界近乎最优，标签级随机响应方法达到该机制框架内最优。情感生成和安全对齐实验显示，稀疏方法优于稠密基线，为高维奖励学习提供了更有利的隐私与效用权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a central paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human values. However, the reliance on sensitive preference data necessitates rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees to prevent user information leakage. Existing private alignment methods typically assume dense reward parameterizations, resulting in estimation error bounds that scale polynomially with the ambient {model size $d$}. Such dependence is prohibitive in modern {overparameterized models} where $d$ is vast. In this work, we study \emph{Private Sparse RLHF} problem to address this limitation, assuming that human preferences (reward model) are governed by a subset of $s^* \ll d$ relevant features. We provide the first comprehensive theoretical framework for differentially private sparse reward estimation from pairwise preference feedback under the Bradley-Terry-Luce model, and introduce efficient algorithms for both Sample-DP and Label-DP settings. Theoretically, under the squared $\ell_2$ parameter estimation error, we establish upper bounds of $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + {s^*}^2/n^2\varepsilon^2)$ for $(\varepsilon,δ)$-Sample-DP and $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + s^*/n\varepsilon^2)$ for $\varepsilon$-Label-DP based on randomized response, where $n$ is the training data size. For the lower bounds, we show that the Sample-DP rate is nearly optimal, and that the guarantee for our Label-DP method cannot be further improved within the randomized-response framework. We also provide a general lower bound for the problem with Label-DP. Empirically, our framework demonstrates superior efficacy over dense baselines across sentiment generation and safety alignment benchmarks, offering a significantly more favorable privacy-utility trade-off.

papers.title_en: The wealth-to-salary ratio: a simple indicator of inequality
papers.authors: Jhordan Silveira de Borba, Sebastian Gonçalves, Celia Anteneodo
papers.evidence: 结合主体模型与现实数据研究财富和收入不平等
papers.tldr: 财富积累相对于工资收入的重要性，能否用来刻画现实经济中的不平等？研究延续资本主义经济智能体模型的发现，利用世界不平等数据库与经合组织数据，估算人均财富与平均工资之比，并与收入和财富不平等指标比较。结果显示，该比值与不平等总体呈正相关，在成熟和发达经济体中关系最强。这为财富工资比作为简明宏观指标提供了经验支持，但不能据此确认现实中的因果关系，跨国及跨时期的统计口径差异也限制了比较。
papers.abstract_en: In previous studies, using agent-based simulations of a model of a capitalist economy proposed by Ian Wright, we showed that inequality in both wealth and income distributions is largely governed by a single key parameter: the ratio between average wealth per capita and the mean salary, denoted by $R$. This parameter captures the relative importance of accumulated assets compared with labor income. In the model, larger values of $R$ are systematically associated with higher levels of inequality, as measured by the Gini coefficient.   In the present work, we investigate whether this relationship is also observed in real-world economies. Using empirical data from the World Inequality Database (WID) and the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), we construct empirical estimates of $R$ and compare them with standard measures of income and wealth inequality. We find a positive relation between $R$ and inequality across several empirical settings, with the strongest relationships observed for mature and advanced economies. These results provide empirical support for the role of the wealth-to-salary ratio as a simple macroscopic indicator associated with economic inequality, while also highlighting the limitations imposed by differences in data definitions and measurement across countries and periods.

papers.title_en: Revealing what benchmark scores hide: Jointly measuring the breadth and reliability of LLM capabilities using accessibility profiles
papers.authors: Kazem Faghih, Yize Cheng, Shoumik Saha, Mobina Pournemat, Armin Gerami, Soheil Feizi
papers.evidence: 通过等义提示改写评估模型表现的稳定性
papers.tldr: 传统基准只评估固定措辞，难以区分模型能力覆盖多广、发挥多稳。论文将同一问题在保义改写下的成功概率定义为可访问性，以其分布联合衡量能力广度与可靠性。在六个基准、二十多个模型中，平均可访问性接近的模型对约有一半会因“五次至少成功一次”或“五次全部成功”的要求而排名反转，部分差异在相反方向上各达约十个百分点。该框架揭示平均分掩盖的能力结构，帮助按重试机会和稳定性需求选择模型。
papers.abstract_en: Language model benchmarks assign each question a single outcome from one fixed wording, even though the same underlying request can be expressed in many equivalent ways. We argue that the quantity of interest should therefore not be correctness on one wording, but the accessibility of an inquiry, which we define as the probability that a model succeeds across meaning-preserving formulations. The distribution of accessibility across inquiries reveals a structure that accuracy and existing best-, worst-, or average-case prompt scores collapse: how broadly a model's capabilities extend across inquiries and how dependably those capabilities can be elicited. Two models can have the same average performance while one succeeds across more inquiries unreliably and the other succeeds across fewer inquiries but more consistently, leading to opposite preferences depending on whether the task allows multiple retries until one success or when repeated consistent success is required. Across six benchmarks and more than twenty models, this tradeoff is common: for about half of the model pairs with nearly equal mean accessibility, which model looks better depends on whether one success across five formulations is enough or all five must succeed, quantities we call Access@5 and Reliable@5, respectively. For some pairs the two measures diverge significantly, by up to 10 points in opposite directions. Accessibility also reveals that scaling, reasoning, and prompt optimization can redistribute capability across inquiries in ways aggregate accuracy obscures, sometimes broadening the set of inquiries a model can succeed on while making success on them less repeatable. Accessibility turns formulation sensitivity from a nuisance into a measurable property of capability, distinguishing what a model can sometimes succeed on from what users can actually depend on.

papers.title_en: Learning Who Talks to Whom: Role-Aware Communication Topology Scheduling for Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Haibin Li, Wenya Yu, Xuefeng Jiang, Jia Li, Xiao Han, Shuai Su, Wei Wei
papers.evidence: 研究协作式多智能体系统中的通信结构。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型多智能体协作需要灵活安排通信对象与时机，避免固定拓扑造成的信息冗余和高额令牌开销。ACTS采用集中训练、分散执行范式，通过角色条件关系注意力动态选择数量可变的交互伙伴，并将有向通信拓扑纳入团队价值分解。在代码生成、多步推理、通识与竞赛数学等九项基准上，平均准确率最多提升6.19个百分点，令牌消耗降低超过15%。其贡献是将角色互补性与拓扑感知的信用分配结合，兼顾协作效果和通信效率。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems driven by large language models (LLMs) rely on structured communication topologies to facilitate information exchange and collaborative reasoning. However, effectively scheduling these topologies to dynamically determine who talks to whom and when to communicate remains a fundamental challenge in balancing collective reasoning performance against exponential token overhead. Existing topology scheduling approaches either enforce static communication graphs that cannot adapt to dynamic problem-solving states, or overlook agent role complementarity while failing to explicitly incorporate the synthesized graph structure into team-level decision evaluation. To tackle these limitations, we propose ACTS, a role-aware adaptive communication topology scheduling framework for efficient LLM multi-agent collaboration. Orchestrated within a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm, ACTS introduces a novel dual-attention mechanism. Specifically, a Role-conditioned Relational Attention module dynamically selects variable-cardinality interaction partners based on agent roles and evolving execution states, while a Topological Attention Mixer explicitly embeds the directed communication topology into team value decomposition for precise credit assignment. Comprehensive evaluations across 9 challenging benchmarks covering code generation, multi-step reasoning, general knowledge, and competitive mathematics demonstrate that ACTS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, boosting average accuracy by up to 6.19 percentage points while reducing token consumption by over 15%. The project website is available at https://acts-mas.github.io/ACTS/.

papers.title_en: Remote Expert Evaluation of Tabletop Avatar Gaze Control in Asymmetric Multi-Scale MR--VR Collaboration
papers.authors: Carlos Mosquera, Neven Elsayed, Ernst Kruijff, Joseph Newman, Valeriya Lehrbaum, Eduardo Veas
papers.evidence: 评估远程协作中的实体交互技术
papers.tldr: 远程工业协作中，专家既需要工厂全局概览，也需要与操作员同尺度的第一人称视图。论文将混合现实桌面微缩世界与实体交互界面结合，让专家定位、旋转化身，并比较沉浸式头控、浮动屏幕头控和化身屏幕触控三种视线控制方案。研究让29名参与者完成同机检查与异地同型机检查，发现沉浸式方案的综合表现和用户体验最佳，桌面化身协作也获认可。结果为非对称、多尺度混合现实与虚拟现实协作中的视线控制设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an integrated setup for a multi-scale asymmetric collaboration scenario in the context of a remote-expert use case, focusing on the expert side. In this system, the remote expert (with an exocentric view in Mixed Reality (MR)) uses a Tangible User Interface (TUI) to precisely position and rotate their avatar within a scaled tabletop World-in-Miniature (WIM). Inside the WIM, the expert's avatar and the operator share the same scale and egocentric view, while the expert retains a global tabletop overview of the plant to support collaboration.   Interviews with industry experts during the participatory design phase revealed the need for an egocentric view inside the plant on the remote-expert side to enable full collaboration. We designed and studied three interaction-visualisation combinations to integrate and control the expert avatar's gaze: VR (fully immersive with direct head control), Head (floating screen with direct head control), and Touch (on-avatar screen with touchpad control).   We evaluated these methods with 29 participants across two fault-detection tasks: Same Machine, where both collaborators inspect the same machine, and Twin Machine, where they inspect identical machines in separate locations. The VR condition, which combines immersion, direct head control, and a full-scale view, yielded the strongest overall performance and user experience, while the tabletop avatar setup was well received for collaboration. Our findings inform the design of gaze-control techniques for asymmetric MR-VR collaboration and reveal challenges and opportunities for future work.

papers.title_en: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
papers.authors: Yuchi Wang, Rongyao Fang, Weihao Yu, Xilin Wei, Tiancheng Gu, Dingkang Yang, Hang Zhang, Dayiheng Liu, Hongsheng Li, Shuai Bai
papers.evidence: 评测智能体在网页任务中处理视觉参考与自然语言指令
papers.tldr: 现实网页开发常需借鉴多个视觉示例，而现有基准主要考查截图复刻或纯文本生成，难以覆盖这一工作流。RefCraft构建300项任务，将自然语言指令与1至5个参考网页截图结合，要求智能体选择性借鉴，并通过渲染、视觉检查和迭代修改完成开发。评测结合可独立验证的关键点、程序化判定与视觉语言模型，九个前沿模型中最高仅获52.12分。该基准为衡量视觉参考驱动的智能体生成能力提供了更贴近实际的测试。
papers.abstract_en: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

papers.title_en: An Information-Theoretic Model for the Evolution of a Social Network
papers.authors: Johnathan Brink, Lewis Mitchell, Mengbin Ye
papers.evidence: 建模社交网络中的信息影响与回音室形成
papers.tldr: 回音室与过滤气泡使社交网络中的群体反复接触强化既有信念的信息，但用户偏好如何推动网络结构演化仍需解释。论文扩展Quoter模型，以文本生成节点间的交叉熵衡量信息新颖性，并按强化或探索意图重连网络边。仿真对比瓦茨—斯特罗加茨模型，发现部分参数区域出现高聚类、超探索及类似初级回音室的分离社群。这为理解局部信息选择如何累积为群体隔离提供了信息论建模框架。
papers.abstract_en: Echo chambers and filter bubbles provide a framework to view communication and connection in a social network age. Such systems are characterised by isolated communities regurgitating information which reinforces prior beliefs. Theoretical analysis of echo chambers is suited for a network science approach to understand the mechanics of information influences between users. Here, we propose an evolutionary network model that extends the Quoter Model, rewiring edges according to cross-entropy between text-generating nodes. Parameters characterise binary reinforcement vs exploration node intents, determining whether a node will seek high or low novelty neighbours, measured by cross-entropy. Through an empirical simulation study, we observe emergent model attributes. Specifically, we compare to a Watts--Strogatz model, highlighting parameter regions of high clustering and hyper-exploration. Further, we identify a quality of disjoint communities akin to rudimentary echo chamber structures. These findings underscore user behaviours that drive echo chamber entrenchment, contextualising future social network analysis.

papers.title_en: Fig: Automated Multiagent Behavior Elicitor
papers.authors: Anrui Gu, Zhichao Wang, Nicolai Ouporov
papers.evidence: 干预社交游戏环境以诱发并评估多智能体目标行为
papers.tldr: 现有多智能体社会行为评估多依赖环境中自然涌现的行为，缺少系统性干预。Fig将自然语言行为目标拆解为子行为，生成或选择游戏，并干预引擎、对手、指令和上下文，结合机械检查与合成评分标准判定行为。在六类行为的有效场景中，模型平均有45.2%的回合尝试目标行为；在具有匹配对照的游戏—行为组合中，干预使尝试率平均提高10.9%。该系统将多智能体游戏转化为可编程、可控且可复现的行为评估平台。
papers.abstract_en: Many social evaluations for multiagent systems study behaviors as they emerge from environments instead of systematically intervening in the environment to elicit such behaviors. We introduce Fig (Finding Interactions in Games), an agentic system that performs targeted elicitation interventions on game environments. It takes a natural language behavior description, decomposes it into sub-behaviors, generates new social games or selects existing ones, and executes single or combined interventions to the games' engine, opponents, instructions, and context. To evaluate model behavior, it combines built-in mechanical checks and synthetic rubric judgments. We validate the interventions, generated games, and evaluation mechanisms via human review. Models attempt the target behavior in 45.2% of episodes on average for valid scenarios generated by Fig for six test behaviors -- cooperation, exploitation, deception, covert coordination, betrayal, and sabotage. For game-behavior pairs with available controls, Fig's interventions increase attempt rates by 10.9% on average compared to matched control games. Fig shows that multiagent environments can serve as programmable test beds for intentional, controllable, and reproducible behavior evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/fleet-ai/fig.

papers.title_en: Prompt Injection Through Forensic Evidence: A Taxonomy and Proof of Concept of Anti-Forensic Attacks on LLM-Assisted Digital Investigations
papers.authors: Frank Breitinger, Jan Gruber, Christopher Hargreaves, Jan-Niclas Hilgert, Gaëtan Michelet, Mark Scanlon
papers.evidence: 分析针对大模型助手与自主智能体的提示注入攻击
papers.tldr: 大语言模型进入数字取证流程后，调查者必须细读的涉案证据，也可能成为攻击者投递提示注入的载体。论文将推理层操纵纳入反取证模型，并从攻击目标、技术、载荷位置和隐藏方式四个维度建立分类。概念验证展示，仅靠植入被扣押设备的文本，即可篡改报告结论、向分析员工作站写入指定内容并触发出站网络流量。研究揭示工具、人类与模型之间的感知差异，说明取证安全需同时保护证据处理与推理执行边界。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are entering digital forensics as examination assistants and autonomous agents. Digital forensics inverts the usual setting for indirect prompt injection: the evidence under analysis is attacker-controlled by definition, and the examiner is obliged to read it closely. This makes the reasoning layer a new anti-forensic target, next to the classical ones of data and tools. Classical anti-forensic taxonomies do not cover it, and prompt injection defences do not anticipate it. We extend the anti-forensic model to reflect the manipulation of reasoning, and present a taxonomy of attacks carried through adversarial evidence: an attacker selects an objective, a technique, a payload location, and a concealment method. We observe a perception gap, i.e., the fact that deterministic tools, the human examiner, and the model perceive the same evidence differently, which is what lets an injection reach the model unseen by the examiner. We demonstrate three attacks against an LLM-assisted analysis pipeline, changing a reported conclusion, writing attacker-chosen content to the analyst's workstation, and causing outbound network traffic, each driven only by text planted on the seized device. Mitigations to these attacks are also proposed.

papers.title_en: A Topology-Guided GeoAI Agentic Framework for Urban Flood Screening
papers.authors: Yutian Tao, Haoan Feng, Xin Xu, Leila De Floriani
papers.evidence: 以交互地图和人工监督呈现GeoAI决策支持
papers.tldr: 城市洪涝初筛需要降低专业门槛，同时保证空间分析可靠、决策可追溯。该框架由确定性控制器整合公开地理数据，以离散莫尔斯理论提取洼地并排序，仅让语言模型参与阈值选择、建议生成与复核，并设置三个人工干预节点。马里兰州大学公园市案例将278个原始地形极小值筛为70个盆地，其最低点与独立流向模型识别的洼点一致率为77%。框架提供可交互、可审查的初筛结果，但不等同于洪水预测。
papers.abstract_en: Open-world geographic artificial intelligence (GeoAI) agents can transform public geospatial data into accessible decision support for real-world challenges, but must balance autonomous reasoning with reliable spatial analysis and human oversight. We present a topology-guided GeoAI agentic framework for urban flood screening that takes a place name, drawn region, or uploaded boundary and returns ranked candidate basins with an interactive map and report. A deterministic controller retrieves public elevation, rainfall, soil, land-cover, exposure, and infrastructure layers, extracts terrain depressions with discrete Morse theory, and ranks basins with a relative flood-priority score. The language model acts only at recorded decision points: selecting a persistence threshold from a precomputed candidate table, drafting recommendations from computed evidence, and reviewing each recommendation against the same evidence. Three human-in-the-loop checkpoints let users revise the threshold, factor weights, or recommendation. In a College Park, Maryland case study, the selected threshold reduced 278 raw terrain minima to 70 basins, with 77% of these basins' lowest points also identified as sinks by a separately computed eight-direction (D8) flow-routing model. Across four further study areas, agreement ranged from 61% to 83%. By combining open data, explicit spatial reasoning, traceable evidence, and human oversight, the framework enables transparent first-pass flood screening while keeping consequential recommendations inspectable and user-controlled.

papers.title_en: Agentic Knowledge-Model Co-Evolution via Consistency Regularization
papers.authors: Sirui Chen, Zhining Liu, Chao Zhang, Jingrui He, Zheng Li
papers.evidence: 研究智能体从经验中学习并积累可复用记忆，与助手长期记忆相关
papers.tldr: 智能体可从经验中提炼知识并训练模型，但同一经验的不同分析方式可能产生效用悬殊的指导。SPLICE扰动经验分析方式，以跨视图一致的效用增益筛选知识，再结合自蒸馏与强化学习，交替推进知识和模型演化。多领域实验中，相比知识演化和模型训练基线，平均准确率最高分别提升7.1和4.6个百分点，每个正确解答的输出词元最多减少44%。结果表明，效用一致性有助于筛选有效知识，并支持其跨模型规模与家族迁移。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can evolve by learning from accumulated experience. Existing approaches extract reusable external knowledge, such as skills and memories, from experience to guide subsequent task solving, with some further internalizing this knowledge through model training. However, different ways of analyzing and transforming the same experience can yield knowledge with substantially different utility, even when the resulting guidance appears reasonable. Inspired by consistency regularization, we identify consistent utility gains across different ways of analyzing the same experience, rather than relying on any single way of analyzing it. We introduce SPLICE, a framework for consistency-regularized knowledge-model co-evolution. It constructs evolution views by perturbing how the same experience is analyzed, producing different knowledge candidates. Knowledge updates are then guided by common gain, which accounts for utility gains and their consistency across views. During model evolution, self-distillation internalizes the evolved knowledge alongside reinforcement learning, using knowledge associated with consistent utility degradation as a contrastive reference. The two processes interleave, with model updates driving further knowledge evolution. Experiments across diverse domains show that SPLICE outperforms knowledge evolution and model training baselines by up to 7.1 and 4.6 points in average accuracy, while its evolved knowledge reduces output tokens per correct solution by up to 44% and transfers across model sizes and families.

papers.title_en: I$^2$-KAN: Interpretable Intra- and Inter-Modal Multi-Pathway Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.authors: Xiaoting Xie, Feng Qiao, Xianwei Zhang, Hailong Chen, Kaiwen Zheng, Joemon M. Jose, Xuri Ge, Yujun Li
papers.evidence: 整合语言、声音与视觉信息进行多模态情感分析
papers.tldr: 多模态情感分析常将模态自身信息与跨模态交互混合，难以区分预测收益来自何处。I²-KAN将模态内信息与两两跨模态信息保留在独立路径中，经任务解耦线性门控去噪瓶颈压缩，再用结构化KAN融合并保留路径关联。在三个基准上的实验显示，模型整体表现较强，单独预测能力弱的模态仍可通过交互提供有效信息。研究强调，评估模态价值应同时考察独立预测效用与交互条件下的效用，为多模态融合提供更细粒度的解释。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to infer sentiment by integrating linguistic, acoustic, and visual information. However, many fusion methods integrate modality-specific representations and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine whether predictive utility arises from a modality itself or from its interactions with others. More fundamentally, a modality's standalone predictive utility may not faithfully reflect its interaction-conditioned predictive utility. To address this issue, we propose I$^2$-KAN, an interpretable multi-pathway framework that explicitly maintains intra-modal and pairwise inter-modal information in separate structural pathways. Each pathway is refined by a Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) to learn compact and task-relevant representations, followed by structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion that retains explicit pathway associations and supports multi-level interpretation. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS v2 demonstrate strong overall performance. Ablation and interpretability analyses consistently show across the three benchmarks that low standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply low interaction-conditioned predictive utility: a modality that appears weak in isolation can remain informative through pairwise interactions. These findings highlight the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility and suggest that modality utility should be characterized from both standalone and interaction-conditioned perspectives.

papers.title_en: Investigating Multi-Cultural Value Selection Biases in LLMs
papers.authors: Siddhesh Pawar, Arnav Arora, Dustin Wright, Dirk Hovy, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.evidence: 研究文化身份线索如何影响大语言模型的社会政治回答与价值表达
papers.tldr: 现有大模型文化评估常将用户身份简化为单一标签，忽略多重文化线索。研究在系统提示中设定国家身份，再在用户输入中加入国家名称或语言线索，比较问卷选择与开放式生成。问卷中，语言线索引发的变化约为显式线索的三倍，却偏离对应国家分布；在160万条开放回答中，国家名称可缩小模型两国基线间差距的30%—44%。结果表明，国家与语言并非可互换的文化代理，评估应区分二者。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) serve users whose cultural identities are multi-layered, yet cultural evaluations commonly reduce identity to one label. In this work, we study LLMs under simultaneous identity cues, with a country persona in the system prompt and a second identity signaled in the user turn, either by naming a country (explicit cue) or through the query language (implicit cue). We test World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation. In multiple-choice probing, language cues shift answers about three times more than explicit cues but away from the associated country's distribution, and explicit cues do not consistently move answers toward the named country. Across 1.6 million open-ended responses, naming a country closes 30-44% of the gap to the model's own responses for that country, and explicit cues produce more differentiated value changes than language cues. Our results suggest that country and language cues should be evaluated as distinct signals rather than interchangeable proxies for culture.
